description.value: This generator increases the mass of creatures struck by the weapon, causing gravity to affect them more heavily. When you critically hit a flying creature with a Strike with the installed weapon and deal damage, the target immediately falls up to 20 feet to the nearest surface and reduces its fly Speed by 5 feet for 1 minute. Subsequent successful Strikes against the same creature further reduce its fly Speed each time. This upgrade has no effect in zero gravity.
